name: pitchMin
meaning: ALPHAMIN converted from degrees by deg*2048/180 (0x4a1081 at CameraRestriction init 0x4a1113). If min == max in 4096 units but the raw degrees differ (e.g. 0 and 360), min = 0 and max = 0x1000 (full circle).

name: distMin
meaning: DISTMIN. The lower clamp in Camera_ApplyRestriction. Camera_SolveCollision raises the TOO-FAR base distance to it when it is larger.

name: pitchMax
meaning: ALPHAMAX in 4096 units. Camera_SolveCollision sets 0x6e4388 bit0 (overhead restriction, no blocked counting) when pitchMin > 0x37f and pitchMax < 0x481.

name: aimOffset
meaning: (AIMCORRECTIONX, -AIMCORRECTIONZ, AIMCORRECTIONY): the designer's Z-up axes mapped to x/vertical(down)/z. Added to the request aim offset in UpdateFollow and UpdateSamChase.

name: eyeVertMax
meaning: -ALTITUDEMIN. Passed as maxVert to Camera_SolveCollision, which clamps eye.y to at most this value, so the eye cannot go below the altitude (vertical points down). 32000 when there is no restriction.

name: trajectory
meaning: First entry of the TRAJECTORY id-list, a Trajectory {u16 count; Vec3s pts[]}. NULL if absent or count == 0. When set, the restriction is a rail camera (Camera_FollowTrajectory) and pad control is forbidden.

name: pitchSpeed
meaning: ALPHASPEED deg/s * 2048/180. Replaces speeds[0] when the pitch was clamped.

name: yawSpeed
meaning: BETASPEED in angle units per second. Replaces speeds[1] when the yaw is clamped, and in the yaw-snap path of UpdateFollow.

name: rollSpeed
meaning: GAMMASPEED in angle units per second

name: focal
meaning: FOCAL: when nonzero it overrides the desired projection focal (Screen_SetProjection distance)

name: flags
meaning: CamRestrictFlags as one-bit fields (CamRestrictBits): SNAPBETA, FORBIDPADCONTROL, MIRRORBETAINTERVAL and the MISCFLAGS bits remapped (see the enum)

name: influenceBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: INFLUENCEBOXES id-list, from Scn_FindIdList. The restriction activates while the Wolf (or the Robot) is inside one of these boxes (BoxList_FindContainingPoint in 0x4a0dc0). | count (+4): count of influenceBoxes
